artifacts.summary: Finds the target gate-collision file already exists (9 Conditions, dependency on BimodalLogic task 785 dropped at migration); drafts Condition 10 naming the nolints.json narrow-remedy route and deciding ledger-row vs in-source set_option for the unusedArguments batch-linter category.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system's lean extension, agent-system/extensions/lean/context/project/lean4/patterns/plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md is a living checklist that multiple independent tasks append numbered Conditions to over time (confirmed: Conditions 1-9 already exist, authored by commits c48adb7cf, 6ffc0f227, dd51473b8 -- unrelated to any single task's own description). A task whose description claims this file 'does not exist yet' may be stale: always read the file directly before trusting a dispatch's claim about a shared, append-only guidance file's current state, especially after a cross-repo task migration (check state.json's migrated_from.dropped_dependencies for edges that were silently dropped rather than satisfied).

For Mathlib-style Lean linting: a batch/environment-linter finding (e.g. unusedArguments, raised via lake exe runLinter / #lint) is suppressed by an external ledger (nolints.json) or an in-source @[nolint <name>] declaration attribute -- never by set_option. set_option linter.<name> false only controls elaboration-time linter diagnostics (e.g. unusedVariables, unusedFintypeInType), which is why the two suppression styles can coexist on the same declaration for different finding categories. A plan pre-authorizing a set_option suppression for a batch-linter category risks a silent no-op.
